What Happens: Types a request, asks a question, or fills a form
Why It Matters (in plain words): Starts everything — no AI cost yet

What Happens: Reads the request, decides which steps are needed and in what order
Why It Matters (in plain words): The 'traffic controller' — no reasoning, just routing rules

What Happens: Picks the cheapest AI model smart enough for that specific task
Why It Matters (in plain words): Keeps cost low by not always using the most expensive AI

What Happens: Lets the AI actually use your tools (Airtable, docs, files) safely
Why It Matters (in plain words): No manual copy-paste; AI acts directly inside your apps

What Happens: Stores what happened so the next request has full context
Why It Matters (in plain words): Nothing gets 're-explained' every time — it remembers

What Happens: Final answer, document or action appears where you expect it
Why It Matters (in plain words): You just see the finished output, not the process
